documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 818.7 crores with EBITDA of INR 54.9 crores and PAT of INR 39.5 crores. The company is in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary with an initial funding of INR 2 to 5 crores to expand into broader jewellery categories such as silver, platinum, and lab-grown diamonds. Management highlighted that the newly introduced bridal jewellery segment accounts for approximately 10% of total manufacturing volume and aims to scale its corporate business share from 51% to 65%. Additionally, sales volume reached 577 kgs for Q2 FY27, up 10% year-on-year. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported H1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹1,367.15 crore, up 58.7% YoY, driven by growth across corporate and non-corporate clientele.

guidance.claim: The company targets scaling its corporate client business share from 51% to 65%.
guidance.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

guidance.claim: Management expects the bridal jewellery segment to potentially reach a volume level comparable to its core business in two to two-and-a-half years.
guidance.quote: This share s expected to continue growing; in fact, within two to two-and-a-half years, it could potentially reach a level comparable to our core business.

guidance.claim: The company expects to execute the launch of its new subsidiary within two to three months.
guidance.quote: given that the approval is already in place, I expect us to exccute everything within two to three months.

guidance.claim: The company expects production to ramp up in coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry demand environment remains encouraging with the festive and wedding season underway.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the industry, the demand environment remains encouraging, particularly with the festive and wedding season underway.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for lightweight jewellery, contemporary designs, and affordable products continues to create new opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the lightweight jewellery, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Corporate jewellers in India are expanding rapidly with pipeline programs for new showrooms.
demand_outlook.quote: Today we have a massive volume of orders.

demand_outlook.claim: The company complements in-house capacity with outsourced production to address growing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: To meet growing demand, the company complements its in-house capacity with outsourced production.

demand_outlook.claim: Retail expansion by corporate clientele is expected to generate additional product demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand across the broader jewellery value chain.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term expansion strategy, we are in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand our presence across the broader jewellery value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed subsidiary will be funded with a initial investment of INR 2 crores to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We can, but for this, we have thought that first we open a subsidiary with a very minimal fund, like INR2 crores, INR4 crores, INRS crores at most, since it is a new venture.

capex_expansion.claim: Shringar House is actively expanding its geographical reach across high-potential organized jewellery retail markets.
capex_expansion.quote: On the geographical front, we are actively expanding our presence across high-potential markets where organized jewellery retail is gaining traction.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested approximately ₹15 crore from internal accruals for capacity expansion and machinery upgrades.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production from the relocated capacity resumed on February 23, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune.
capex_expansion.quote: Opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans strategic expansion through a wholly owned subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: Establishment of a wholly owned subsidiary

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 54.9 crores with an EBITDA margin of 6.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR54.9 crores, a 68.7% growth Y-0-Y, while EBITDA margin stood at 6.7%, a growth of 50 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs increased as the company expanded capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes and hired additional staff for new segments.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

margins_costs.claim: Company profitability improves when gold prices increase because manufacturing charges are calculated on a percentage basis.
margins_costs.quote: If gold prices increase, our profitability actually improves.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 PAT grew to ₹73.47 crore with a margin of 5.37%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 FY27 sales volume stood at 577 kgs, representing a 10% year-on-year increase.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the quarter stood at 577 kgs, up by 10% Y-0-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: The bridal jewellery segment accounts for approximately 10% of total manufacturing operations.
orders_capacity.quote: So, within our entire manufacturing operations, the bridal jewellery segment accounts for approximately 10%.

orders_capacity.claim: More than 90% of revenue is generated through repeat orders from existing showroom clients.
The company possesses an annual integrated manufacturing capacity of 4,000 kg.
orders_capacity.quote: 4,000 kg p.a Capacity in an integrated manufacturing facility

orders_capacity.claim: New capacity was added in February 2026, bringing full-year blended capacity to 2,625 kg with actual capacity utilization at 87%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

capital_allocation.claim: Managing cash flow effectively is the company's top operational priority.
capital_allocation.quote: Limited cash flow management is our top priority today.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains at least 30% or more of its inventory hedged.
capital_allocation.quote: Right now we keep at least 30% plus hedged inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: Shringar House currently carries approximately 400 kgs of gold inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: Approximately 400 kgs is our inventory, 400 kgs.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash outflow improved in H1 FY27 due to lower working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.

capital_allocation.claim: Company listing helped raise growth capital.
capital_allocation.quote: Listing of the company enabled growth funds

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility and uncertainty have made consumers more cautious regarding their jewellery spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations require significant working capital and liquidity for expansion across multiple locations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our operations are working capital intensive, requiring adequate liquidity and funds to support business expansion and diversification across multiple locations

management_commitments.claim: Shringar House targets scaling its corporate business share from 51% to 65%.
management_commitments.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to execute the establishment of its wholly-owned subsidiary within two to three months.
management_commitments.quote: given that the approval is already in place, I expect us to exccute everything within two to three months.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the bridal segment to potentially reach a scale comparable to its core business within two to two-and-a-half years.
management_commitments.quote: This share s expected to continue growing; in fact, within two to two-and-a-half years, it could potentially reach a level comparable to our core business.

management_commitments.claim: Production from newly installed capacity is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
